note: Everything needed to run this sketch is in git (cal/, 8 MB). The items below are optional: raw downloads, licensed fonts and the research dossier. Paths are relative to the shared assets root (WC_ASSETS, default ~/Box/2026 Realtime Weather).

items.about: NASA Worldview snapshots as downloaded (MODIS Aqua true colour 1800×900 JPEG and L2 chlorophyll PNG for 36 candidate days, June–October 2012) plus index.json. tools/prep.py turns these into cal/. Reproducible with tools/fetch_cal.py.
ABC Diatype Regular and Medium as .woff2. Licensed, never committed. Without them the page uses an installed Diatype, then Helvetica/Arial.
Research dossier for the site: readings, news PDFs, imagery, geodata, LINKS.csv, README. Reference only; the sketch does not read it.
